title: Most Unfortunate Woman in Re:Zero
text:
Garf and Frederica's mother is one of the most unfortunate women in the entire story.
Her life was truly full of twists and turns, and basically all in a terrible direction.
Alongside Otto Suwen, she could serve as one of the twin pillars of Re:Zero's most tragic lives.
Muria Tinsel. This name might never appear in the main story, though.
